use forge::prelude::*;
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ExportRequest {
    pub format: String,
    pub include_archived: bool,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ExportResult {
    pub url: String,
    pub row_count: i64,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct VerifyInput {
    pub user_id: Uuid,
    pub email: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct VerifyOutput {
    pub verified: bool,
}

#[forge::job(timeout = "5m", retry(max_attempts = 3))]
pub async fn export_users(ctx: &JobContext, request: ExportRequest) -> Result<ExportResult> {
    Ok(ExportResult { url: "/tmp".into(), row_count: 0 })
}

#[forge::workflow(name = "verify_account", version = "2026-01", timeout = "1h")]
pub async fn verify_account(ctx: &WorkflowContext, input: VerifyInput) -> Result<VerifyOutput> {
    Ok(VerifyOutput { verified: true })
}
